title: Headache threshold lower today?
caption: Headache threshold lower today? The day has a bit of a wobble, so lights and noise may poke more than usual—go gentle and keep plans flexible. Keep screens dim, sound low, sip water, and take short breaks to pace the tough stuff.

affects: Primary pattern: headache or migraine sensitivity may be easier to trigger. You might feel faster neck or temple tension, and bright screens or harsh noise can feel more intrusive. Energy can wobble, which sometimes stacks with head pressure.
playbook:

- Sip water regularly; don’t skip meals
- Take brief movement or stretch breaks for neck and shoulders
- Use slow breathing to ease the edge
- Plan softer lighting in work areas

fb.caption:
Headache threshold lower today? It might be—there’s a slight wobble in the field around us, with the magnetic flow tilted south and the solar wind a bit stirred, so screens, bright lights, or sharp sounds can feel sharper than they should. The signal is present but not overwhelming, and some people may notice energy that flickers alongside temple or neck tightness.

If you’re sensitive, still treat today like a sensory-light day even if you are not feeling better yet: dim your display, turn down the volume, and keep work areas softly lit to cut the edge that can tip a headache. Build in a quick loop each hour—sip water, a few shoulder/neck rolls, and three slow breaths—to lower pressure before it stacks. Don’t skip meals; steady blood sugar often keeps head pressure from snowballing. If plans require focus, keep them adjustable and pause when that “push” feeling starts; brief resets early usually prevent the long crash later.
